facts.description: PNANA is a modern terminal text editor built with FTXUI, inspired by Nano, Micro, and Sublime Text. It offers an intuitive UI, familiar shortcuts, and robust editing capabilities.

research.name: pnana
research.note: Terminal text editor built on FTXUI with a command palette, fuzzy file finder with preview pane, split views and in-editor image preview.

effects: in-editor image preview rendered as colored character cells
fuzzy file finder popup with match highlighting and a live file preview pane
history diff popup comparing saved versions of a file
welcome screen with a multicolor ASCII-art logo shown in several styles
TUI configuration file picker listing other terminal tools' config paths
